description: Use this when someone asks about heating oil prices across Ireland today, the national average, or which county is cheapest or dearest. Returns every county's lowest current published delivered price for 500 litres of kerosene (home heating oil), with the average of those county prices and a page to cite. Reference prices, not quotes. For one county use tankful_county_supplier_prices.
name: tankful_national_prices
title: Heating oil prices across Ireland today
